name: Guidepoint
description: Guidepoint is a research enablement platform and one of the largest expert networks globally, founded in 2003 by Albert Sebag. Originally launched as Clinical Advisors to match cancer patients with clinical trials, the firm pivoted to the broader expert-network model and now connects more than 5,000 client organizations with 1.75 million+ advisors across 150+ industries. Guidepoint differentiates through breadth of coverage, flexible pricing, healthcare data products (Qsight), and its 2025 launch of Guidepoint360 — an AI-powered platform merging expert knowledge with generative AI via its AskGP interface.

overview: Guidepoint is one of the largest expert networks globally, connecting more than 5,000 client organizations with 1.75 million+ advisors across 150+ industries and 500+ subsectors. The firm operates as a research enablement platform — providing not just expert access but also healthcare data intelligence (Qsight), content libraries (Guidepoint Insights with 65,000+ transcripts), live events (1,500+ per month), and since October 2025, the Guidepoint360 AI platform with its AskGP conversational research assistant. Guidepoint is privately held and founder-led by Albert Sebag, who serves as CEO. The company has grown from ~800 employees in 2020 to 1,600+ today across 19 global offices.

history.narrative: Guidepoint was founded in 2003 by Albert Sebag, an organic chemist turned patent attorney. Sebag earned his Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry from Northeastern University (with research at MIT) and his J.D. from Boston College Law School. He founded the company as Clinical Advisors, originally matching cancer patients with appropriate clinical trials. As the model expanded into broader healthcare and other industries, the company rebranded to Guidepoint Global in 2007. Through organic growth and acquisitions (Innosquared in 2015, Vista Research), Guidepoint has become one of the 'Big Five' expert networks alongside GLG, AlphaSights, Third Bridge, and AlphaSense-Tegus.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint's core offering: one-on-one and multi-party consultations with advisors from its 1.75M+ network. Guidepoint assigns dedicated project managers to each engagement and emphasizes breadth of coverage across 150+ industries and 500+ subsectors. Calls include full compliance workflow with MNPI screening.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Scalable B2B surveys leveraging Guidepoint's advisor network for quantitative and qualitative market research. Surveys can be paired with follow-up calls and are used for market sizing, competitive benchmarking, customer sentiment, and pricing studies.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Insights
servicesDetailed.description: A content library of more than 65,000 searchable transcripts and audio recordings from expert consultations. Guidepoint Insights provides reusable research content that clients can access without scheduling individual calls, complementing the bespoke call model.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint Qsight
servicesDetailed.description: A dedicated healthcare data intelligence platform providing alternative data products for healthcare and life sciences investors. Qsight offers sales intelligence, industry insights, and data analytics across pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech sectors — a significant differentiator from general-purpose competitors.

servicesDetailed.name: AI Moderation
servicesDetailed.description: An AI-powered moderation capability for expert calls at enterprise scale. AI Moderation automates portions of the expert interaction workflow, enabling faster and more consistent research delivery. Announced in 2025 as part of Guidepoint's broader AI investment.

servicesDetailed.name: Guidepoint360 / AskGP
servicesDetailed.description: Launched in October 2025, Guidepoint360 is a unified platform merging AI and expert knowledge. AskGP is its conversational AI research assistant that synthesizes insights across Guidepoint's content library and expert interactions. A mobile app followed, delivering AI-driven research on the go.

servicesDetailed.name: Events
servicesDetailed.description: Guidepoint hosts 1,500+ live events per month including roundtables, teleconferences, and industry panels. Events bring together multiple advisors and clients around specific industry themes, providing broader perspective-gathering beyond one-on-one calls.

aiPlatform.narrative: Guidepoint's AI strategy has accelerated significantly in 2025. The centerpiece is Guidepoint360, launched in October 2025, which consolidates all client content — transcripts, call recordings, project briefs, and research — into a single AI-powered platform. AskGP, the conversational AI interface within Guidepoint360, lets clients query the full content library in natural language and synthesize insights across multiple expert interactions. Guidepoint also announced AI Moderation for enterprise-scale expert calls, and in early 2026 launched a Guidepoint360 mobile app for AI-driven research on the go.

complianceExtended.narrative: Guidepoint positions compliance as a core brand differentiator. The firm maintains a dedicated global compliance function with compliance officers assigned to each engagement. Advisors undergo multi-layer vetting including compliance tutorials, conflict-of-interest screening, and ongoing monitoring. Guidepoint's client dashboard provides compliance personnel with tools to download interaction records, audit engagement history, and manage restricted lists. The firm describes its compliance approach in three phases: pre-engagement screening, during-engagement monitoring, and post-engagement auditing.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: No major public regulatory enforcement actions were identified against Guidepoint in this review. The firm has operated since 2003 without significant public compliance incidents. As with all expert networks, Guidepoint operates in an environment shaped by the SEC's 2022 Risk Alert on expert networks, which was industry-wide and not directed at Guidepoint specifically.

clientFit.narrative: Guidepoint serves the broadest client base among the Big Five expert networks, with 5,000+ organizations including institutional investors, consulting firms, corporates, legal teams, and government agencies. The firm's positioning emphasizes breadth, flexibility, and competitive pricing — making it accessible to teams with varying budgets and research intensity. Qsight provides a uniquely specialized offering for healthcare investors.
